newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE Q1 LOSS 7.87 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE Q1 LOSS 7.87 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Rakvere meat factory, the largest meat processor in Estonia, had a loss of 7.87 million kroons in the first quarter, it said on Monday.
"It was a planned loss...due to the rise in raw material prices in the market," Teet Soorm, finance director, told Reuters.
Soorm said that Rakvere was already in profit in the second quarter of the year but he would not give any figures.
The company's turnover was 137 million kroons in the first quarter of the year.
The loss was 3.2 million kroons smaller than planned, it added in a statement.
Turnover has grown by 22.9 million kroons or 17 percent from the same period in 1996, the company said in a statement.
The reason behind the turnover rise was 14 percent growth in production capacity and a price increase of three percent.
Rakvere Meat factory estimates its net profit at 12.3 million kroons for 1997 and as of the end of first quarter it was on target, it added.
The company's assets were 474 million kroons at the end of the first quarter, up 6.8 percent from the last quarter.
